4289-the-duchess-of-berry-and-the-court-.title: The Duchess Of Berry And The Court Of Charles X
4289-the-duchess-of-berry-and-the-court-.creator: Unknown
4289-the-duchess-of-berry-and-the-court-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. rward the title of Charles X., sobbing, embraced them all. They knelt about the bed. The De Profundis was recited. Then the new King sprinkled holy water on the body of his brother and kissed the icy hand. de Blacas, opening the door of the Gallery of Diana, called out: "Gentlemen, the King!" And Charles X.

alcabitius-isagoge-1521-latin.title: Isagoge ad magisterium iudiciorum astrorum
alcabitius-isagoge-1521-latin.creator: Al-Qabīsī (Alcabitius)
alcabitius-isagoge-1521-latin.description: Al-Qabīsī's Isagoge (10th c.) — the standard medieval beginners' introduction to astrology, with John of Saxony's commentary; Latin, Venice 1521. No public-domain English translation exists (Burnett/Yamamoto 2004 = copyright).

arxiv-2008-09210.title: Studying the potential of Graphcore ® IPUs for applications in Particle Physics
arxiv-2008-09210.creator: Lakshan Ram Madhan Mohan, Alexander Marshall, Samuel Maddrell-Mander, Daniel O’Hanlon, Konstantinos Petridis, Jonas Rademacker, Victoria Rege, and Alexander Titterton
arxiv-2008-09210.description: Abstract This paper presents the first study of Graphcore’s Intelligence Processing Unit (IPU) in the context of particle physics applications. The IPU is a new type of processor optimised for machine learning. Comparisons are made for neural-network-based event simulation, multiple-scattering correction, and flavour tagging, implemented on IPUs, GPUs and CPUs, using a variety of neural network architectures and hyperparameters.

arxiv-2110-05483.title: Stochastic approach for assessing the predictability of chaotic time series using reservoir computing
arxiv-2110-05483.creator: I. A. Khovanov
arxiv-2110-05483.description: Abstract The applicability of machine learning for predicting chaotic dynamics relies heavily upon the data used in the training stage. Chaotic time series obtained by numerically solving ordinary differential equations embed a complicated noise of the applied numerical scheme. Such a dependence of the solution on the numeric scheme leads to an inadequate representation of the real chaotic system.

arxiv-2111-09381.title: MEDCOD: A M edically-Accurate, E motive, D iverse, and CO ntrollable D ialog System
arxiv-2111-09381.creator: Rhys Compton Ilya Valmianski Li Deng Costa Huang Namit Katariya Xavier Amatriain Anitha Kannan Curai
arxiv-2111-09381.description: Abstract We present MEDCOD , a M edically-Accurate, E motive, D iverse, and Co ntrollable D ialog system with a unique approach to the natural language generator module. MEDCOD has been developed and evaluated specifically for the history taking task.

arxiv-2204-06976.title: Arithmetic level raising on certain quaternionic unitary Shimura variety
arxiv-2204-06976.creator: Haining Wang
arxiv-2204-06976.description: Abstract . In this article we prove an arithmetic level raising theorem for the symplectic group of degree four in the ramified case. This result is a key step towards the Beilinson–Bloch–Kato conjecture for certain Rankin-Selberg motives associated to orthogonal groups within the framework of the Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture.

arxiv-2206-01221.title: Itinerant spin polaron and metallic ferromagnetism in semiconductor moiré superlattices
arxiv-2206-01221.creator: Margarita Davydova, Yang Zhang, Liang Fu
arxiv-2206-01221.description: Abstract Itinerant spin polaron and metallic ferromagnetism are theoretically predicted in the Mott insulator in semiconductor moiré superlattices doped below and above half filling of the narrow moiré band, respectively. The existence of spin polaron can be directly identified from the kink in the dependence of the charge gap on the magnetic field.

arxiv-2206-06307.title: Towards Constructing Finer then Homotopy Path Classes
arxiv-2206-06307.description: Abstract This work presents a new path classification criterion to distinguish paths geometrically and topologically from the workspace, which is divided through cell decomposition, generating a medial-axis-like skeleton structure. We use this information as well as the topology of the robot to bound and classify different paths in the configuration space.

arxiv-2208-00668.title: Topological entropy of a rational map over a complete metrized field Thanks: This project started when the first author was supported by the ERC-starting grant project ”Nonarcomp” no.307856. The first author also acknowledge the support of the National Science Foundation under Grant No. 1440140, whi
arxiv-2208-00668.creator: Charles Favre, Tuyen Trung Truong, Junyi Xie
arxiv-2208-00668.description: Abstract . We prove that the topological entropy of any dominant rational self-map of a projective variety defined over a complete non-Archimedean field is bounded from above by the maximum of its dynamical degrees, thereby extending a theorem of Gromov and Dinh-Sibony from the complex to the non-Archimedean setting.

arxiv-2305-06437.title: Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning via Latent Time Navigation
arxiv-2305-06437.creator: Di Yang, Yaohui Wang, Quan Kong, Antitza Dantcheva, Lorenzo Garattoni, Gianpiero Francesca, François Brémond
arxiv-2305-06437.description: Abstract Self-supervised video representation learning aimed at maximizing similarity between different temporal segments of one video, in order to enforce feature persistence over time. This leads to loss of pertinent information related to temporal relationships, rendering actions such as ‘enter’ and ‘leave’ to be indistinguishable.

arxiv-2308-11836.title: Characterizing normal perinatal development of the human brain structural connectivity
arxiv-2308-11836.creator: Yihan Wu, Lana Vasung, Camilo Calixto, Ali Gholipour, Davood Karimi
arxiv-2308-11836.description: Abstract Early brain development is characterized by the formation of a highly organized structural connectome. The interconnected nature of this connectome underlies the brain’s cognitive abilities and influences its response to diseases and environmental factors. Hence, quantitative assessment of structural connectivity in the perinatal stage is useful for studying normal and abnormal neurodevelopment.

arxiv-2309-16656.title: Visual In-Context Learning for Few-Shot Eczema Segmentation
arxiv-2309-16656.creator: Neelesh Kumar, Oya Aran, Venugopal Vasudevan
arxiv-2309-16656.description: Abstract Automated diagnosis of eczema from digital camera images is crucial for developing applications that allow patients to self-monitor their recovery. An important component of this is the segmentation of eczema region from such images. Current methods for eczema segmentation rely on deep neural networks such as convolutional (CNN)-based U-Net or transformer-based Swin U-Net.

arxiv-2311-13551.title: Differentiating by prime numbers
arxiv-2311-13551.creator: Jack Jeffries
arxiv-2311-13551.description: Abstract It is likely a fair assumption that you, the reader, are not only familiar with but even quite adept at differentiating by x . What about differentiating by 13? That certainly didn’t come up in my calculus class! From a calculus perspective, this is ridiculous: are we supposed to take a limit as 13 changes?

arxiv-2312-04866.title: Understanding oscillating features of the time-like nucleon electromagnetic form factors within the extending vector meson dominance model
arxiv-2312-04866.creator: Bing Yan, Cheng Chen, Xia Li, Ju-Jun Xie
arxiv-2312-04866.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Bing Yan, Cheng Chen, Xia Li, Ju-Jun Xie. We investigate the nonmonotonic behavior observed in the time-like nucleon electromagnetic form factors. Using a phenomenological extending vector meson dominance model, where the ground states ρ \rho and ω \omega and their excited states ρ ⁡ ( 2 ​ D ) \rho(2D) , ω ⁡ ( 3 ​ D ) \omega(3D) , and ω ⁡ ( 5 ​ S ) \omega(5S) are taken into account, we have successfully reproduced the cross sections of e + ​

arxiv-2402-17097.title: Re-Ex : Revising after Explanation reduces the Factual Errors in LLM Responses
arxiv-2402-17097.creator: Juyeon Kim Jeongeun Lee Yoonho Chang, Chanyeol Choi Junseong Kim Jy-yonh Sohn
arxiv-2402-17097.description: Abstract Mitigating hallucination issues is a key challenge that must be overcome to reliably deploy large language models (LLMs) in real-world scenarios. Recently, various methods have been proposed to detect and revise factual errors in LLM-generated texts, in order to reduce hallucination. In this paper, we propose Re-Ex , a method for post-editing LLM-generated responses.

arxiv-2402-18500.title: Conditional Independence of 1D Gibbs States with Applications to Efficient Learning
arxiv-2402-18500.creator: Álvaro M. Alhambra, Ángela Capel, Paul Gondolf ∗ *, Alberto Ruiz-de-Alarcón, Samuel O. Scalet
arxiv-2402-18500.description: Abstract We show that spin chains in thermal equilibrium have a correlation structure in which individual regions are strongly correlated at most with their near vicinity. We quantify this with alternative notions of the conditional mutual information, defined through the so-called Belavkin-Staszewski relative entropy.

arxiv-2509-14397.title: Projective Plane Subdivision Method For Initial Orbit Determination
arxiv-2509-14397.creator: Ruiqi Huang, Anton Leykin, Michela Mancini
arxiv-2509-14397.description: Abstract Initial Orbit Determination (IOD) is the classical problem of estimating the orbit of a body in space without any presumed information about the orbit. The geometric formulation of the “angles-only” IOD in three-dimensional space: find a conic curve with a given focal point meeting the given lines of sight (LOS).

arxiv-2509-25713.title: Reweighted Flow Matching via Unbalanced OT for Label-free Long-tailed Generation
arxiv-2509-25713.creator: Hyunsoo Song, Minjung Gim, Jaewoong Choi
arxiv-2509-25713.description: Abstract Flow matching has recently emerged as a powerful framework for continuous-time generative modeling. However, when applied to long-tailed distributions, standard flow matching suffers from majority bias, producing minority modes with low fidelity and failing to match the true class proportions.

pmc-10665966.title: Consistency and Adequacy of Public and Commercial Health Insurance for US Children, 2016 to 2021
pmc-10665966.creator: Jamie R. Daw, Sarra Yekta, Faelan E. Jacobson-Davies, Stephen W. Patrick, Lindsay K. Admon
pmc-10665966.description: Key PointsQuestionHow do the rates and child and family characteristics associated with inadequate and inconsistent health insurance coverage compare for publicly vs commercially insured children in the US?FindingsThis cross-sectional study of 203 691 children found that publicly insured children experienced higher rates of inconsistent coverage, whereas commercially insured children faced higher rates of inadequate coverage.

pmc-11674161.title: The Role of Transarterial Embolization Plus Radiotherapy Compared to Radiotherapy or Transarterial Embolization Alone in the Management of Painful Bone Metastases: Results of a Systematic Review
pmc-11674161.creator: Antonio Vizzuso, Matteo Renzulli, Valentina Lancellotta, Alessandro Posa, Patrizia Cornacchione, Bruno Fionda, Ciro Mazzarella, Davide De Leoni, Luca Tagliaferri, Emanuela Giampalma, Roberto Iezzi, Yusuke Shiozawa
pmc-11674161.description: Simple SummaryThis study examines the use of transarterial embolization (TAE) combined with radiotherapy (RT) for treating bone metastases, which can cause severe pain and complications. By combining TAE and RT, the researchers aimed to evaluate whether this approach improves disease control and pain relief more effectively than RT or TAE alone.

pmc-12418702.title: Assessment of risk factors and ultrasonographic characteristics for the differentiation between malignant and benign thyroid nodules in Beni-Suef governorate, Egypt
pmc-12418702.creator: Ahmed Moheyeldien Hamed, Khaled Elsayed Elhadidy, Mahmoud Farid Kamel, Ahmed Sayed Abd El Basset, Ahmed Saad Ahmed, Saeed M Shaaban, Nadia Ahmed Abd El-Moeze, Hazem Samy Matar
pmc-12418702.description: BackgroundThyroid nodules (TNs) are frequent and often benign. Accurately differentiating between benign and malignant nodules is crucial for proper management. This research aims to use ultrasonography to examine TNs and identify possible risk factors in order to improve patient outcomes and diagnostic accuracy.

pmc-12533179.title: DNA StairLoop: enabling high-fidelity data recovery and robust error correction in DNA-based data storage
pmc-12533179.creator: Zihui Yan, Guanjin Qu, Xin Chen, Gang Zheng, Huaming Wu
pmc-12533179.description: High-throughput electrochemical synthesis is an emerging DNA synthesis technology that has attracted considerable attention due to its scalability and cost-effectiveness. However, its high error rates and poor synthesis uniformity pose significant challenges for applications in DNA data storage, where high fidelity is essential.

pmc-13073072.title: The Biological Activities of Mango Seed Fractions and Its Hepatoprotective Effects on Alcoholic Liver Disease and Modulation of Intestinal Flora
pmc-13073072.creator: Zaixiang Lou, Xu Cheng, Zejun Pei, Caihua Liu, Zhengjie Zhu, Yuemei Liao, Huili Huang, Rui Huang, Yaqin Li
pmc-13073072.description: In this study, the active components in the seed of Mangifera indica L. were isolated, the main chemical components were identified, and then their antioxidant activities and their effects on liver injury and intestinal microbiota were evaluated. The results showed that all the components of mango column chromatography exhibited antioxidant activity. F2 had the lowest IC50 value of 93.

pmc-13166671.title: Massive jejunal hemorrhage secondary to Dieulafoy’s lesion in a young male with congenital urogenital anomalies: a rare case report
pmc-13166671.creator: Shaheen Abshar, Azizullah Mohammadi, Abdulwaly Jalal, Aida Bidar, Mikdolina Seddiqi, Mansoor Ahmad Faizi
pmc-13166671.description: Introduction and importance:Dieulafoy’s lesion (DL) is a rare but potentially life-threatening vascular anomaly that can cause severe gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding. While it most commonly occurs in the stomach, jejunal involvement is exceedingly rare and poses significant diagnostic challenges.Presentation of case:We report a 25-year-old male with a history of congenital urogenital anomalies who presented with melena and hematochezia for 7 days.

pmc-13263138.title: CytoSignal detects locations and dynamics of ligand–receptor signaling at cellular resolution from spatial transcriptomic data
pmc-13263138.creator: Jialin Liu, Hiroaki Manabe, Weizhou Qian, Shion Orikasa, Javid Ghaemmaghami, Yichen Wang, Yichen Gu, Angel Ka Yan Chu, Gaurav Gadhvi, Yuxuan Song, Patrick McClinden, Vibha N. Lama, Noriaki Ono, Joshua D. Welch

pmc-13610626.title: PSMA-Targeted Liposomes for Therapeutic Delivery into a Prostate Cancer Cell Model
pmc-13610626.creator: Miguel Ferreira, Neelum Aziz Yousafzai, Lital Ben Naim, Bahar Ataeinia, Umar Mahmood, Pedram Heidari
pmc-13610626.description: Background: Prostate cancer (PCa) remains a significant health challenge, requiring innovative treatments. Here, we evaluated the efficacy of Talazoparib-loaded liposomes incorporating a targeting moiety, in combination with BI 2536, in PCa. This study develops lipid nanoparticles (LIPOs) targeting prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA) for better drug delivery.

pmc-13626890.title: Neuromuscular control strategies during the Tai Chi heel-kick movement across different levels of motor experience
pmc-13626890.creator: Ze Huang, Junyu Gao, Luming Chen, Xiaoshan Lei
pmc-13626890.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to examine differences in neuromuscular control strategies during the Tai Chi heel-kick movement between practitioners with different levels of motor experience by integrating estimated spinal segmental motor output, muscle synergy analysis, antagonist muscle co-contraction, and joint coordination assessment.

pmc-13629129.title: Dual targeting of interlocked PTK2B and MAPK signaling triggers synergistic ferroptosis via autophagic flux disruption in BRAFV600E glioma
pmc-13629129.creator: Min Wang, Chengyan Xu, Shanshan Xie, Jichen Jin, Pengqi Zhang, Jiyong Liu, Cheng Wu, Yongmei Xi, Xiaohang Yang
pmc-13629129.description: BackgroundBRAFV600E mutation is one of the most common oncogenic drivers in gliomas, sharing the highest incidence in pediatric low-grade gliomas (~ 20%) and being frequently associated with poor prognosis. Although combination therapies targeting both BRAFV600E and downstream MAPK signaling have been developed, their efficacy is substantially limited by acquired drug resistance.

uslaw-usc-t22-s8922.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 96A (Ukraine Freedom Support). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. It is the policy of the United States to further assist the Government of Ukraine in restoring its sovereignty and territorial integrity to deter the Government of the Russian Federation from further destabilizing and invading Ukraine and other independent countries in Central and.
